verdict.rationale: The quickstart tells users to get a TEST API key from the Numeral Dashboard before creating products, calculations, and transactions, which implies a separate test mode. The ping endpoint returns the current environment, so agents can confirm which one they are hitting. Missing for 10: explicit docs that test data is isolated from production filings and nexus, test-mode behavior for the MCP server and agent skills, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox.
